description: [STAGE 2: RULES & RHYTHM] Alias of basecoat_rules_enforcer. Retrieve indexed technical implementation constraints.

category.description: Filter rules by technical domain: "tailwind-v4", "fsm-contracts", "tokens", "semantic-html", "dashboard-patterns", or "all".

code.description: HTML/markup snippet to audit against the indexed technical constraints.

componentId.description: Component ID alias to filter relevant rules.

environment.description: Target output environment: "html", "astro", "react", "vue", or "svelte". Defaults to "html".

html.description: Alternative alias for the code parameter to audit against constraints.

id.description: Rule ID or component ID to inspect.

query.description: Search query to match against rule IDs, titles, forbidden patterns, or required syntax.

name: enforce_rules
